representatives: Source uses N exactly when V(input)=1, zero otherwise. Target uses N on every natural input, including malformed and decoded nonuniverse inputs.

internal_typed_propagation_scope: Arbitrary Data/body/variable type/context/symbolic typ; precisely typed(x,typ) AND the same actual Edge(x,y,certificate) imply typed(y,typ).
typed_membership_source: Internal typedRecover at x supplies member(typ)=1. No separate membership premise and no inference from arbitrary V.
